executive_summary: Getinge delivered strong Q3 2025 with 9.5% organic sales growth - the highest quarterly performance in 2025. All business areas contributed positively with Life Science rebounding strongly (+15.9%) and ACT maintaining momentum (+11.4%). Despite SEK 108M tariff headwind, margins improved. Cardiosave CE Mark reinstated. Management reaffirmed >12% EPS CAGR target despite tariffs.
key_highlights: Net sales +9.5% organic - strongest quarter of 2025
T-DOC powers Sweden's first fully automated CSSD

ceo_letter.author: Mattias Perjos
ceo_letter.title: President & CEO

promises.statement: With current tariff levels, Getinge expects to reach the target of >12% average annual growth in adjusted EPS 2024-2028
Net sales for 2025 expected to increase by 2-5% organically

challenges.challenge: Tariff impact SEK 108M in Q3 (SEK 218M YTD)

honesty_signals: Explicitly quantifies tariff impact (SEK 108M Q3, 218M YTD)
Shows margin bridge with and without tariffs/FX for transparency
Cardiosave reinstatement noted as subject to conditions
Tracks key strategic KPIs visually over time

key_quotes.quote: With current tariff levels, Getinge expects to reach the target of >12% average annual growth in adjusted EPS 2024-2028
Efforts to mitigate negative impact from tariffs are clearly working
Strong performance in the quarter with solid organic growth

key_narratives: Life Science rebound (+15.9%) after earlier weakness
Cardiosave quality issues being resolved (CE reinstated)
Manufacturing excellence driving lead time and cost improvements
mda_analysis.management_interpretation: Management presents Q3 as validation of their strategy execution. The emphasis on tariff mitigation success and Cardiosave reinstatement signals confidence that major headwinds are being managed. The explicit reaffirmation of long-term EPS target is significant.

Acute Care Therapies.name: Acute Care Therapies
Acute Care Therapies.management_commentary: Strong 11.4% organic growth. Gross margin improved to 56.6% (from 54.8%). Cardiosave CE Mark reinstated.

Life Science.name: Life Science
Life Science.management_commentary: Rebound with 15.9% organic growth. Manufacturing Excellence reducing lead times 20%+ and COGS ~10% on some products.

Surgical Workflows.name: Surgical Workflows
Surgical Workflows.management_commentary: Modest 4.7% organic growth. T-DOC at Malmö University Hospital. Philips partnership for anesthesia workstations.

operational_highlights: Cardiosave CE Mark reinstated (subject to conditions)
T-DOC software at Sweden's first fully automated CSSD (Malmö University Hospital)
Philips partnership for integrated anesthesia workstations in CE markets
V12 stent EU MDR approval for BEVAR, FEVAR and IBD indications
Manufacturing Excellence: 20%+ lead time reduction, ~10% COGS reduction in Life Science
concerns_mentioned: Cardiosave reinstatement subject to certain conditions

targets.notes: Explicitly reaffirmed even with current tariff levels

guidance.commentary: Management explicitly reaffirmed long-term EPS target despite tariff headwinds. This is a stronger signal than simply 'maintaining' - it's proactive restatement of confidence.
